cohort: Patients whose fetuses had fetal heart rate abnormalities, categorized into cases with acidosis (arterial pH < 7.00) and controls without acidosis at birth.
finding: The CAESARE tool demonstrated high sensitivity (0.97) and specificity (0.88) in predicting acidosis, with the potential to avoid 32.1% of neonatal acidosis cases and enable extended expectant management in 42% of cases where intervention was initially recommended.
mod_finding: The CAESARE tool influenced decisions regarding the continuation of labor, associating with increased end of labor in acidosis cases and greater expectant management in non-acidosis cases.
